tools.name: token_risk
tools.description: Honeypot and rug-pull check for an ERC-20 on Base or Ethereum before a swap, approval or signature, read straight from the contract: upgradeable proxy (EIP-1967, beacon, clone), owner powers in the bytecode (mint, pause, blacklist, fee or max-tx setters, trading switch, burn from any address), owner

tools.name: buy_pack_with_card
tools.description: For businesses without USDC: 5,000 calls €9.00, one-time, 90 days, businesses only, paid in EUR by card or Link. Returns checkout_url for a person to open; the checkout asks for the company or freelance name. After payment the success page (Accept: application/json) returns the key, and it is e-mail

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "token_risk" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
